title: Neighborhood Access Grant Down Payment Application on the Closing Disclosure
content:
**Larkspur Neighborhood Access Grant (Closing Cost Credit program) — paying the down payment**

On the day of the scheduled closing, while the loan file is clear to close and its Closing Disclosure has been issued, a verified Larkspur Neighborhood Access Grant pays the down payment on that Closing Disclosure, and one application entry is booked for the down payment, naming that Closing Disclosure and the award entry it draws on.

The down payment entry of a Neighborhood Access Grant is not fixed until its ledger carries the closing-cost entry for the Closing Disclosure the loan closes on. In the same terms: as long as the grant's ledger carries no closing-cost entry for the Closing Disclosure the loan closes on, the amount of the down payment entry is not yet fixed.

| Condition on the day of the scheduled closing | Reading |
|---|---|
| Grant verified, file clear to close, Closing Disclosure issued | the grant pays the down payment on that Closing Disclosure |
| One down payment application | one entry, naming the Closing Disclosure and the award entry drawn on |

### Situation of use and effect of the tool

`post_down_payment_credit_64b83335` books the part of a verified closing cost credit that pays the borrower's down payment on a Closing Disclosure. One call books one application entry for the down payment cost category against the named Closing Disclosure, drawing on the named award entry of the same credit, and lowers the credit's available balance by the amount booked. Afterwards the credit's ledger shows the down payment application entry and the reduced available balance.

### How it is invoked

It is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `post_down_payment_credit_64b83335` and then calls it.

### Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `credit_award_id` | Reference number of the verified closing cost credit being applied, as shown by the closing credit lookup for the loan file. | An identifier, as shown in the lookup. |
| `disclosure_id` | Reference number of the Closing Disclosure the down payment is paid on, as shown by the loan disclosure lookup for the same loan file. | An identifier, as shown in the lookup. |
| `source_entry_id` | Reference number of the award entry on this credit's ledger that the application draws on, as shown by the credit ledger lookup for the credit. | An identifier, as shown in the lookup. |
| `entry_amount` | Amount of the credit applied to the down payment. | US dollars as a plain positive number with exactly 2 decimal places (cents), no currency sign or thousands separators; stored as given, rounded to 2 decimal places. |

### Return

> Down payment application <entry_id> booked: <amount> of credit <credit_award_id> on disclosure <disclosure_id>; available balance <balance>.

<entry_id> is the reference number of the new application entry; <amount> and <balance> are US dollars with 2 decimals. Receiving this line means the application is on the credit's ledger; the call has succeeded when the receipt is returned.
